distribution.narrative: Wang et al. (2024) report Qingdao, Shandong. Mandelshtam & Petrov (2019) additionally report mainland China without specifying a locality. The existing mainland occurrence assessment remains Candidate pending separate review.

host_note: Host names reported by cited sources, not independently confirmed. Non-taxon or unverified verbatim host terms excluded from the structured host list: rarely on Picea abies. The regional occurrence assessment is not changed.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Hylastes opacus Erichson, 1836.
